summary: All candidate utilities and exam day modules for job alerts and admit card notifications have been built, integrated, compiled, and verified. Included 1-click Google Calendar / .ics sync, client-side Photo & Signature compressor, multi-cadre Post Preference matrix, interactive Permitted vs Barred exam day checklist with dress code rules, TCS iON center transit locator with Google Maps integration, live multi-shift difficulty & good attempts briefing, printable emergency undertaking declaration form, and WhatsApp/Telegram instant alert banners.
